name: Erode Armaments reduces enemy attack power from Wand attacks (#1949)
contract: Erode Armaments 520386 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Erode Armaments 300157, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the ranged class damage of Wand of Time or Artificer's Wand (100% chance), a single Artificer's Wand hit should apply the attack-power debuff to the target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Erode Armaments debuff before any cast
Artificer's Wand hit applies Erode Armaments
